title: Snap closures broke with first use
text: Snap closures broke with first use. This comes with some extra snap closures, but what’s the point since all but 1 cracked with just one use. It’s fine for providing cover for a cake or cupcakes, but not suitable for transport since the clasps are so fragile and break with the slightest pressure.

product_metadata.title: Ohuhu Cake Carrier Lid Handle Plastic Cake Containers Portable Round Cake Holder Cupcake Carrier Two Sided Base for Pies Cookies, Nuts Fruit etc - Suitable for 10 inch Cake Perfect Gifts
features: Multiple Uses: Not only can this handy device hold 10in cakes and 11 cupcakes or muffins, but you can also use the compartment tray for an assortment of appetizers and snacks such nuts, fruit, veggies, salads, cookies or crackers for any occasion!

Ingenious Design: No more struggling to carry your goodies, just use the easy-carry handle, which also folds in place when not in use. You won't have to worry about anything spilling out, either, since the 3 locking clips keep the cover on tight. We even include 3 bonus locking clips as replacements!

Anti-slip Design: Everyone's worst nightmare is spilling the cake on the ground, but you can count on Ohuhu to never let you down! The non-slip base will keep any cake firmly in place while you're carrying it or have it in the car with you.

Large Capacity: Baking a large cake? No worries, it will fit! Measuring a full 12 inches in diameter at the base (11 inches of the cake tray) and 6in in height, this tray can fit cakes up to 10in. From Christmas to birthday parties, anniversaries or other holidays, you can't go wrong with this useful tray.
Food-Grade Materials: We put your health first, and made this cake carrier with food-grade PP material, ensuring you and your food stay healthy, fresh and safe for all your friends and family!
